confusions: search seems to require every query word to match a title/summary: a natural multi-word query returned []; single words worked. Content search appears to OR words ("Update 2026" matched 'created: 2026') and returns each snippet twice.
`related` returns only direct metadata links (concepts, sources, workspaces); following a concept gives notes on that concept only - no cross-concept, cross-course or correction links.
`inspect workspace-…` omits the CONTEXT.md body (Open Questions, Deferred), so those had to be read from the file.
No read query for inbox items or Garden seeds (status only counts them; search types inbox/garden return []). The Nebula view requires generating views.
Deprecated notes carry no supersedes link to their successors; the only way to list corrected notes was content-searching the frontmatter word 'deprecated'.
project-tessera lists milestone_ids that inspect cannot resolve ('record not found').
corrective_steps: Used an empty query `search "" --type note --limit 200` to get the full title list, then note-read per note.
Read workspace CONTEXT.md, inbox and Garden files directly (canonical data, not implementation).

Termin registered 2026-10-06 10:00-12:00; stopped at step 4 of the stride example on 2026-09-16; three deprecated->corrected note pairs plus batch-norm qualification; no mastery claims.
